title: Bà kể chuyện
about: Round 33, ke-chuyen-gan ("hãy tiếp tục sáng tác album mới, theo phong cách ambient và dễ ngủ"), for a new album, Những giấc mơ nhỏ: grandmother's story, E minor at 58 bpm. Its motif speaks: a note said twice, then up the chord (B-B-E-G), answered by a sigh down a step; the middle in G major reaches C6. Written to sleep to, on the sound the user settled on (ke-chuyen-gan: the piano near, a wide hall, a soft echo): its tune moves by step and stays low, its sentences come back with small changes (each middle section 16 bars, a sentence and its variation), the left hand rocks in eighths through most of it, the climax stays low. An original tune.
